_README: EVERY price on the site comes from this file. Nothing is hard-coded anywhere else. Set `price` values in whole USD. While a price is 0 the site shows 'Price on request' instead of $0, and the quote builder refuses to show a total.
_depositPercent: Percentage of the total taken as a booking deposit. Shown under every total.
_minimumOrder: If a built quote totals less than this, the site shows the minimum instead. Set to the Starter price so nothing is quoted below the cheapest pack.

launchDiscount.forFirstBrandsText: Launch rate for our first 3 brands, booking by {date}.
launchDiscount._note: When enabled, the normal price is struck through and the discounted price shown beside it. Set `percent` to e.g. 20 for 20% off. `forFirstBrandsText` takes a {date} token, filled from seasonBanner.bookByDate in site.json so the launch deadline and the Ramadan booking deadline stay the same date. Put the brand count in the text once decided.
launchDiscount.forFirstBrandsTextAr: سعر الإطلاق لأول ٣ علامات تحجز قبل {date}.
launchDiscount._appliesTo: Pack keys the launch discount applies to. Empty or missing = all priced packs.

starter.label: Starter
starter.blurb: Small brand, one model, half a day.
starter._price: Flat price for the Starter pack. Half shoot day, up to ~10 products, 1 model. Derived from a half-day at ~60% of a full day; keeps R39,936 after 15% withholding and 10% commission. Revisit when First Productions quotes a half-day.

ramadanEid.label: Ramadan & Eid Content Pack
ramadanEid.blurb: 1 hero shoot day, 30 finished images, 10 vertical videos. Delivered in about 3 weeks.
ramadanEid._price: Flat price for the Ramadan & Eid pack. This is the headline offer.

seasonPartner.label: Season partner
seasonPartner.blurb: 2–3 shoot days across the season, for brands that need content every month.
seasonPartner._price: null means no price is shown and the button reads 'Talk to us' instead of loading the builder.

base._price: Base price the quote builder starts from before any options are added. Equivalent to the Ramadan & Eid pack baseline: 1 shoot day, 1 model, standard location, 30 images, 10 videos.

choices.label: 1 model
choices._price: Added to base. Model fee for one model for the shoot day.

choices.label: 3 or more
choices._price: Added to base. Final count confirmed in the quote.

modesty.label: Model look and modesty level
modesty._note: Does not change the price by default — set prices here if a particular treatment costs more to cast or shoot.

choices.label: Premium location (e.g. Atlantis Dunes — permit and transport)
choices._price: Added to base. Should cover the permit fee and 4x4 transport.

choices.label: Paid ads
choices._price: Added to base. Paid media usage costs more.

choices.label: Website and marketplaces
choices._price: Added to base. Covers Salla, Zid, Noon and the brand's own site.

extraImages.label: Extra images
extraImages._pricePerBlock: Price per block of 10 extra finished images.

extraVideos.label: Extra vertical videos
extraVideos._pricePerBlock: Price per block of 5 extra vertical videos.

liveView.label: Watch the shoot live (video link)
liveView._price: Flat add-on. Client joins a live video link during the shoot day.

included._editRounds: Two rounds, set 25 November 2026. A round means adjusting agreed work in the shot list, not re-shooting to a new brief. Stated in /terms/ clause 7 and on the Approvals section — change all three together.
